Huix makziyáti quilistacna.

Qui Dios, lucmaxquiyan, paxcatcatzinilh.
Lantla nquimaquiya nchali chali;
Ankalhin huix huanti nquimaktakalhpat.
Lu tlanca mintamaktay Tlati Dios.

Lu tlanca huix qui Dios,

Acxni cucxilha huantu ntlahuanita,

Man huix huanti lu lakchananin cacni,

Tlati qui Dios huixinti ncaquimaqui
Huix caquimpulalipi ankalhin
Lantla ntlihueklh nactayayi cmintiji.
Chali, chali, caclakachixcuhuin.

Asta uma nquincamaktayani nqui Dioscan
Ni ucxní lhtu quincamakaxtaknitan xla
Calimaxquihu lhuhua lipaxcatcatzínilh.

Ayí makalhsputapalayahui uma ncat
Hua nqui Dioscan huanti nquincatatlahuán
Chali chali quinca mahuin qui Dioscan.
//Asta uma nquincamaktayani nqui Dioscan//.

Hua nqui Dioscan quinca, malacnuninitan
Mpi ankalhin naquincamaktayayán
Masqui camilh ntu naquincalaksokaliyan
Hua nqui Dioscan hua ntlihueklh naquincamaquiyan.
Hua lapi quin ankalhin hua nalipahuanau.
